topics.title: Topics, Partitions & Append-Only Log Mechanics
topics.objective: Understand distributed partition layouts, record offsets, and sequential disk I/O throughput.
topics.exercise: Configure a Kafka topic with 6 partitions and evaluate message distribution using Murmur2 key hashing.

topics.title: Producer Reliability: acks=all, Idempotence & Retries
topics.objective: Prevent message loss or duplicates during producer network timeouts using transactional sequence IDs.
topics.exercise: Implement an idempotent Kafka producer publishing orders with guaranteed exactly-once local semantics.

topics.title: Consumer Groups, Partition Rebalancing & Offset Management
topics.objective: Scale message consumption linearly across worker pools and manage manual offset commits safely.
topics.exercise: Build a multi-threaded consumer worker group committing offsets only after database persistence succeeds.

topics.title: Schema Registry, Avro & Backward/Forward Evolution
topics.objective: Enforce strict serialization contracts and manage payload schema evolution without breaking downstream consumers.
topics.example: record OrderCreated { string order_id; double amount; [null, string] discount_code = null; }
topics.exercise: Evolve an Avro event schema by adding an optional field and verify backward compatibility via Schema Registry API.

topics.title: Kafka Streams: RocksDB State Stores & Windowed Aggregations
topics.objective: Compute real-time rolling metrics across streaming event data using tumbling and hopping windows.
topics.exercise: Implement a fraud detection stream counting high-value transactions within 60-second sliding windows.
